edges.reason: The sweet_berry_bush is adjacent to the oxeye_daisy in the garden; locating the daisy confirms the player is in the garden area where the bush can be mined
The note_block is in the music room accessed via a doorway at the end of the redstone-lamp-lit hallway
The gray_stained_glass partition is visible from the hallway exit, past the redstone_lamps that guide navigation southward
The emerald_block is inside the vault room behind the gray_stained_glass partition wall, accessed through a doorway at x=2,z=10
The chiseled_stone_bricks form the vault walls accessible only after navigating past the glass partition to the vault doorway
